rows.advice: Spend the hottest hours somewhere cool
rows.ask: Which place is open, accessible and staffed?
rows.placeholder: e.g. the community hall on Station Road, open 11 am to 6 pm

rows.ask: Where is safe water reliably available?
rows.placeholder: e.g. free water at the market gate and both bus stands

rows.advice: Rest in the shade during the hottest hours
rows.ask: Which work arrangements make a break possible without losing pay?
rows.placeholder: e.g. the market committee has moved loading to 6–11 am

rows.advice: Ask for help if you or someone near you feels unwell
rows.ask: Which number or contact is answered, and by whom?
rows.placeholder: e.g. ward health helpline 1800-000-000, staffed 8 am to 10 pm

note: Advice should acknowledge what people need in order to follow it. Only confirmed provisions go into the message.

source.label: MCR2030, 2025, p. 38 (Cape Town’s ‘message coupling’, learned in its 2017 drought and planned for heat)
